 1                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Call the 

 2    roll.

 3                 (The Secretary called the roll.)

 4                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator 

 5    Borrello to explain his vote.

 6                 SENATOR BORRELLO:   Thank you very 

 7    much, Madam President.  

 8                 First of all I'd like to thank the 

 9    sponsor, Senator Hinchey, for this bill.  I think 

10    the idea of having a database, a searchable 

11    database for farms and farm products is a noble 

12    effort.

13                 Unfortunately, after recent events 

14    there's going to be a lot less information in 

15    that database because of a devastating blow that 

16    was paid to our farmers by the unelected Wage 

17    Board, the Farm Labor Wage Board.  

18                 These three unelected people had 

19    determined that they're going to do something 

20    that no other state around us has done, and that 

21    is to lower the threshold on overtime from 

22    60 hours eventually down to 40 hours.  

23                 Not only is this a problem for 

24    farmers, it's actually a problem for farmworkers, 

25    the people that they are supposedly trying to 


                                                                463

 1    benefit.  But after hours and hours of testimony, 

 2    we heard from farmers, farmworkers, people in 

 3    agriculture that this will be bad.  That the 

 4    farmworkers, the guest workers that come into our 

 5    country legally from other countries will choose 

 6    other states instead of New York State.  And 

 7    farmers, already under a lot of pressure from bad 

 8    policy in New York State and forces that they 

 9    don't control, like the price that they get for 

10    their product, have told us that they will get 

11    out of the business.  

12                 So unfortunately, this database 

13    could be really, really small in not a very long 

14    period of time.

15                 So I call on all of my colleagues to 

16    push back against this.  Because this is still 

17    something that was only a recommendation, a 

18    recommendation to the Department of Labor and to 

19    our Governor.  Reject this recommendation.  

20    Because the only person that voted against it was 

21    the only person on that three-person Wage Board 

22    that actually is in agriculture.

23                 This is clearly rigged, and that's 

24    going to be an issue that is going to create a 

25    devastating impact on New York agriculture.


                                                                464

 1                 So, Madam President, I'm in favor of 

 2    this bill, but in the greater picture I am very 

 3    troubled for the future of New York agriculture.

 4                 Thank you.
